prefix: Full-bleed woodcut relief print filling the entire frame edge to edge, no border, no margin. Bold carved black ink, heavy solid blacks, very few mid-tones.
style: Expressive carved gouge lines like a woodblock, sky carved with long sweeping gouge lines. Printed on warm parchment with visible paper fiber grain and slight ink texture. Graphic, stark, grim, shadow puppet theatre, Darkest Dungeon ink style, linocut, adult and serious, realistic proportions, no gradients, not photorealistic, no text.

jobs.name: p5
jobs.prompt: Winter night, looking down a snowy rutted dirt road to a river ford. In the middle distance the road runs into the black river: a line of flat stepping stones across the shallows, ice along both edges. On the near bank of the ford stand three black iron posts, each topped with a small new black iron cage holding a cold pale blue flame, their blue light glittering on the water as short carved strokes. In the middle of the river a fourth pale blue light hangs just above the water, nothing visible holding it, rings carved on the water beneath it. Bare black winter trees on both sides frame the road. On the road in the middle ground a broken wooden wagon lies on its side, one wheel in the air. In the ditches on both sides of the road stand many drowned dead men and women, gaunt and soaked, river weed hanging from their hair, standing still with slack arms, every face turned toward the road, irregular spacing, varied heights and stances, some turned, some half in shadow. Snow on the banks left as bare pale paper. The only color is the cold pale blue of the iron lamps; everything else is black and deep blue-black ink and pale snow.

jobs.name: p6
jobs.prompt: Dusk, the last light: a deep indigo sky over a thin dull rose band along the horizon. At left, a small camp beside a rutted dirt road: a campfire burning high in ember orange, a log, a bedroll unrolled with a folded blanket on it, a pack. One lone traveler in a long plain dark wool cloak with a deep hood up, seen from behind, sits on the log by the fire reading a folded letter, a small flask on a cord at the wrist; no weapon. Far up the road on the dark hills, the small warm lamps of a village, one lamp higher than the rest. At right, the ground slopes down out of the firelight into cold dark shadow to a wide river smooth as a mirror, flat stones at its edge, holding the last light of the sky. Low through the dark trees upstream by the water, three tiny points of cold pale blue light, unevenly spaced. The warm light is only the fire and the far lamps; everything else is black, deep blue-black ink and the dull rose of the sky.

jobs.name: p7
jobs.prompt: Night, close view from behind and to one side of a hooded traveler in a long dark wool cloak kneeling on flat wet stones at the edge of a black river, leaning over the water, a gloved hand holding a small flask under the surface, rings spreading from it. The traveler's dark hooded reflection lies in the still water below, the face hidden in the hood. Just above the water, level with the hood and an arm's length away, hangs a small black iron cage lamp with a cold pale blue flame, its glare so bright nothing holding it can be seen; its blue light washes along the edge of the hood and glitters on the water as short carved strokes. The only color is the cold pale blue of the lamp; everything else is black and deep blue-black ink.
